scene:
Three zones read left to right, separated by generous space.

LEFT ZONE (narrow), three purposes of learning stacked vertically, each an icon above its label: a question mark with a check mark beside it, labelled ANSWER A QUESTION; a telescope, labelled DISCOVER A NEW ONE; two hands shaking, labelled BUILD RELATIONSHIPS. A navy bracket on their right leads into the middle zone with one arrow.

MIDDLE ZONE, three offer cards stacked vertically, each with one icon and a label: an airplane over a world map on the card labelled FIVE-DAY TOUR; a laptop showing a presenter on the card labelled ONLINE SEMINAR; a warehouse with shelves of boxes and two small visitor figures on the card labelled TWO-DAY VISIT. Only the visit card is highlighted in teal with a large ochre check mark; beneath it, a small tag labelled €1,200 AND 6 PERSON-DAYS.

The five-day tour and online seminar cards have NO outgoing lines or arrows at all; they are drawn slightly faded as options not taken.

RIGHT ZONE, one single arrow runs only from the bottom chosen visit card into three separate boxes stacked vertically, clearly kept apart by gaps: an eye icon, labelled WHAT WE SAW; a speech bubble from a host figure, labelled WHAT THE HOST SAID; a folder of uneven, messy index cards, labelled OUR CUSTOMERS' RECORDS VARY. Three arrows from those boxes converge on one large question-mark lightbulb at the far right, labelled BETTER QUESTION, NOT A FEATURE.

All screens, cards and documents are blank or show only simple shapes; no digits except in the labels.

TEXT: draw exactly these labels, each once and nothing else: ANSWER A QUESTION, DISCOVER A NEW ONE, BUILD RELATIONSHIPS, FIVE-DAY TOUR, ONLINE SEMINAR, TWO-DAY VISIT, €1,200 AND 6 PERSON-DAYS, WHAT WE SAW, WHAT THE HOST SAID, OUR CUSTOMERS' RECORDS VARY, BETTER QUESTION, NOT A FEATURE. Any other text is a defect.
alt: Three purposes of learning, answering a question, discovering a new one and building relationships, lead into three offers for the fictional Northline team: a five-day tour, an online seminar and a chosen two-day visit costing €1,200 and six person-days; the visit is sorted into what the team saw, what the host said and how its own customers’ records vary, which together produce a better question rather than a feature.
caption: Pick the format for what you need to learn, keep observation and explanation apart, and bring home a better question.
